protocols.title: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 (Topical) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Source-reported topical cosmetic formulation guidance, recorded as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Typology's identity profile lists cosmetic formulation levels of 0.5–2.5% for preventive care and 2.5–5% for intensive treatments. It describes topical use in facial-care products (including lash and brow serums and eye creams), hair-care products (including strengthening shampoos and hair serums), and mascaras. These are formulation percentages, not a mass or per-application dose.

schedule.description: Typology lists 0.5–2.5% for preventive cosmetic formulations and 2.5–5% for intensive-treatment formulations. Topical product examples include facial care, lash/brow serums, eye creams, strengthening shampoos, hair serums, and mascara. These are formulation percentages, not administered mass per application.
